campaign_matrix.ad_angle: Start with merit, then show the controlled checkout path.
Show a live catalog, then route the buyer to the lane matching the operational problem.
Position the system as a real operating backend: gated files, gate-backed mailbox records, and payment/approval evidence.
Sell the generosity without giving away the security model.
Give the buyer no-charge split-rule tooling while making the auth boundary explicit.
Show the buyer a routed marketing suite, then keep fulfillment, publishing, ad spend, checkout, and tenancy inside owner-approved gates.
Lead with the one real Free99 console, then route every paid app through platform-aware metering and owner-approved pricing.
